newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower on chart-based selling.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower on chart-based selling.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower as bearish technicals and the current dismal export outlook continued to weigh on the market.
Dealers noted Atwood-Peavey and Wilson Trading sold 1.0 million bu March each, while Cargill Investor Services bought 1.0 million bu December.
Dec closed 3-1/2 cents a bushel lower at $3.98-1/4 with other months off 5-1/2 to 3-3/4 cents.
Estimated volume on wheat totalled 18.93 million bushels.
Barley futures closed steady with December holding at $6.60 per cwt. Volume was estimated at five contracts.
